title: Comprehensive Treatment of Severe Periodontal and Periimplant Bone Destruction Caused by Iatrogenic Factors
authors: Zafiropoulos GG, Parashis A, Abdullah T, Sotiropoulos E, John G. 2018 . Case Rep Dent. :7174608. Ecollection 2018. * Jason® fleece
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “In this case, periimplant infection and tissue destruction resulted from the lack of periodontal treatment/maintenance and failure to use evidence -based surgical and loading protocols. Combination therapy resolved the disease and the patient's severe disc omfort while providing immediate function and an aesthetic solution” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
